name: Nevada Canyon Gold Corp.
description: Nevada Canyon Gold Corp. is a gold exploration company operating in Nevada's prolific Walker Lane gold trend, focused on the Lapon Canyon Gold Project located approximately 40 miles southeast of Yerington, Nevada. The company holds a $5M exploration earn-in agreement for a 50% interest in the project, plus a 3% net smelter return royalty, with Lapon Canyon hosting historical high-grade gold mineralization including underground workings with historical assays in the one-ounce-per-ton range. Nevada Canyon is in the exploration stage, with a 2026 reverse circulation drill program underway targeting deeper intrusion-related gold structures and resource expansion.
